## BNK-0296 [建议]
判据: BNPL Diamond: Eligibility Segments and Minimum Spend Requirements Explained
提示: ## Eligibility segments - Your account must be classified under the eligible segment: HIGH_SPEND_RETAIL. - Segment classification is based on your customer profile and historical usage patterns. ## Minimum average monthly spend requirement - You must maintain an average monthly spend of at least $502500.00 over the evaluation period. - Both card and account spend may be considered, provided those transactions settle within the evaluation period. ### How your spend is evaluated - We calculate your average by summing settled transactions over the evaluation period and dividing by the number of months. - Reversals, refunds, and chargebacks reduce the calculated average. - If your average falls below $502500.00, you will not meet the spend criterion for the period. ### Quick checklist before you proceed - Confirm your current segment is HIGH_SPEND_RETAIL. - Verify your average monthly spend meets or exceeds $502500.00. - Ensure recent adjustments (refunds or credits) have been accounted for in your average.
出处: tau2doc:doc_buy_now_pay_later_bnpl_diamond_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0297 [建议]
判据: BNPL Diamond: Enterprise Revenue Criteria and High-Limit Qualification
提示: ## Minimum annual revenue for enterprise qualification - Enterprise applicants must demonstrate annual revenue of at least $50125000.00. - Revenue is assessed using current, verifiable financial statements for the most recent fiscal period. ### What to prepare for revenue verification - Audited or reviewed financial statements covering the full fiscal year. - Management accounts if the fiscal year-end is older than six months. - Bank statements or tax filings that corroborate figures shown in the statements. ## High-limit qualification - Your total outstanding balance across all BNPL Diamond plans cannot exceed $2505000.00. - Even if you meet the revenue threshold, new plan requests may be reduced or declined if they would cause you to surpass $2505000.00. ### Practical guidance - Keep recent statements ready to confirm you meet or exceed $50125000.00. - Before requesting a new plan, check your current outstanding balance to ensure capacity remains under $2505000.00.
出处: tau2doc:doc_buy_now_pay_later_bnpl_diamond_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0298 [建议]
判据: BNPL Diamond: Understanding Your Maximum BNPL Limit and Concurrent Plans
提示: ## Your overall BNPL cap - The total outstanding balance across your BNPL Diamond plans must remain at or below $2505000.00. - Capacity for new plans equals $2505000.00 minus your current outstanding principal balance. ## Concurrent plan cap - You may keep up to 25 active BNPL Diamond repayment plans at any given time. - A new plan will be declined if it causes your active plans to exceed 25 even if you are under $2505000.00. ### How approvals are evaluated - A plan request is reviewed against both criteria: - Total outstanding after adding the new plan must be ≤ $2505000.00. - Total number of active plans must be ≤ 25. ### Managing within your caps - Pay down existing plan balances to free up capacity under $2505000.00. - Close fully repaid plans to free a slot under the 25 cap. - When scheduling new purchases, consider both your remaining monetary capacity and the number of available plan slots.
出处: tau2doc:doc_buy_now_pay_later_bnpl_diamond_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

判据: BNPL Diamond: 12-Month Standard Term and Flexible Repayment Options
提示: ## Standard term - If you do not choose a custom schedule, your plan defaults to a 12-month repayment term. ## Flexible term range - You may select a custom term between 7 and 18 months, in whole-month increments. ### Term summary | Option | Allowed length (months) | | --- | --- | | Standard term | 12 | | Flexible term | 7 to 18 | ### Choosing your term - Align the term with your cash flow forecast and purchasing cycle. - Longer terms reduce monthly installment amounts but extend the repayment horizon. - If no selection is made at setup, the plan proceeds at 12 months. ### Implementation notes - Your installment schedule is calculated at plan creation based on the selected term length. - Changing the term after activation may not be available; choose carefully during setup.

## BNK-0300 [建议]
判据: BNPL Diamond: APR, Introductory Interest-Free Period, and Late Payment Fees
提示: ## Standard APR - A standard APR of 12.49% applies to outstanding BNPL Diamond balances as set out in your plan documentation. - Interest begins to accrue after any applicable introductory period ends. ## Introductory interest-free period - Purchases may be interest-free for 3 months from plan start. - If 3 is 0, interest accrues from the plan start date. - After the interest-free window ends, the then-outstanding principal is subject to 12.49%. ## Late payment fees - If an installment is overdue, a fee equal to 2.5% of the overdue installment amount is applied. - Example calculation: Late fee = Overdue installment × 2.5%. - Late fees may be assessed per missed due date until the overdue amount is cured.
